description: Source code for the SHT3XD sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing communication with the sensor via I2C, including measurement commands, CRC calculation, data fetching, and sensor initialization.

methods.name: sht3xd_compute_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC for a 16-bit sensor value using a specific polynomial.

methods.name: sht3xd_write_command
methods.description: Sends a command to the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: sht3xd_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a register value to the sensor with CRC.

methods.name: sht3xd_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches measurement data from the sensor.

methods.name: sht3xd_channel_get
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to human-readable values.

methods.name: sht3xd_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, sets measurement mode, and clears status.
